q09_emit_delay/postgres.sql:
SELECT wiki, count(*) AS events,
       percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delay_ms) AS p95_delay_ms
FROM (
    SELECT wiki, (extract(epoch FROM emitted_at - event_ts) * 1000)::bigint AS delay_ms
    FROM bench.events_1m
    WHERE emitted_at IS NOT NULL
) AS d
GROUP BY wiki
ORDER BY events DESC, wiki
LIMIT 10

q09_emit_delay/trino-iceberg.sql:
WITH d AS (
    SELECT wiki, date_diff('millisecond', event_ts, emitted_at) AS delay_ms
    FROM iceberg.bench.events_1m
    WHERE emitted_at IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT wiki, delay_ms,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wiki ORDER BY delay_ms) AS rn,
           count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wiki) AS n
    FROM d
)
SELECT wiki, max(n) AS events, min(delay_ms) FILTER (WHERE rn >= ceil(0.95 * n)) AS p95_delay_ms
FROM ranked
GROUP BY wiki
ORDER BY events DESC, wiki
LIMIT 10

q09_emit_delay/trino-postgres.sql:
WITH d AS (
    SELECT wiki, date_diff('millisecond', event_ts, emitted_at) AS delay_ms
    FROM postgresql.bench.events_1m

           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wiki ORDER BY delay_ms) AS rn,
